[P2] Establish the post-maxLifetime reuse contract

Following both timeout bullets, this sentence guarantees a fresh instance for the same session ID after `maxLifetime` as well as after idle expiry. The PR description cites live evidence only for idle expiry; it neither supports the `maxLifetime` reuse claim nor marks it "unverified." Worker source inspection cannot establish this service-side behavior. This breaks rule 6, **Mark unverified assumptions**, and gives callers an unsupported guarantee when planning subsequent jobs. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6: establish the lifecycle contract with service documentation or real-component evidence, or explicitly mark the assumption unverified for maintainer review.
